description: Pull the latest numbers from one connected platform right now and refresh its hosted Postgres table on Autario. Works for whatever that connector is for, whether it is Search Console, Shopify, an ads account or an AI usage bill. Use when health.state is stale or never_ran, or the user says "get the latest". The answer is the finished run: status (refreshed | failed), rows, dataset_id and `health` with one outcome per report (delivered | empty | not_fetched, with the sentence why) and next_step. An empty report is not an error: the account has no such data. It does NOT start a run that cannot help and says why instead: needs_sign_in (the login is gone, give the user next_step.url), already_running, or too_soon (one run per connector per 10 minutes; retry_at says when). Call it ONCE per question, never in a loop. It cannot change settings, reports, schedule or the login. Get the connector_id from list_connectors. Deterministic fetch, no LLM cost. Requires AUTARIO_API_KEY.

connector_id.description: The id of the connector instance to refresh (from list_connectors).

name: refresh_connector
